narrative: On 11 August 2026 I found an Instagram shop called LuxeTime Watches (@luxetime.ae) advertising luxury watches at good prices. I spoke with a seller called 'Khalid' on WhatsApp (+971 52 884 7719). I agreed to buy a Rolex Datejust 36 for AED 18,500 and transferred the money by bank transfer on 14 August to a company account he gave me (Bright Star General Trading FZE). The watch never arrived. On 19 August he asked for another AED 2,750 for a 'customs clearance deposit' which he said was refundable, and I paid it. After that he kept delaying, then stopped answering. By 25 August my calls were blocked and the Instagram shop disappeared. I have the full WhatsApp conversation and my bank statement showing both transfers. I want my money back and I want this seller stopped — I don't think I am the only victim.
